sources.label: Philippine Electrical Code (PEC) 2017 Part 1, Article 6.90 — Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Systems
sources.description: Governs PV system installation including module mounting, inverter requirements, wiring methods, overcurrent protection, and disconnect requirements.

sources.label: RA 9513: Renewable Energy Act of 2008
sources.description: Provides the regulatory framework for renewable energy systems in the Philippines including net metering, FIT rates, and tax incentives for solar PV installations.

sources.label: PEC 2017, Section 6.90.3 — Grid-Interactive PV System Requirements
sources.description: Specific requirements for grid-tied PV systems including anti-islanding protection, utility disconnect, and labeling.

sources.label: DOE Net Metering Guidelines — Distributed Generation for Solar PV
sources.description: Department of Energy guidelines for net metering interconnection of solar PV systems to the distribution grid.
